payload.description_html: Geographical distribution of metriacanthosaurid theropods in Yunnan, Sichuan, and Chongqing, China. Yuanmouraptor type locality indicated with a blue theropod silhouette. Each number indicates an individual: 1, Shidaisaurus jinae; 2, 'Szechuanosaurus' zigongensis; 3, CNM V214; 4, Sinraptor hepingensis; 5 & 6, Yangchuanosaurus shangyouensis.
